nights.title: Yandel
nights.name: Yandel
nights.extract: Llandel Veguilla Malavé, best known by his stage name Yandel, is a Puerto Rican singer who is a member of the reggaeton duo Wisin & Yandel. He released his first solo album, Quien Contra Mí, in 2003. His second solo studio album, De Líder a Leyenda, was released in 2013 and was certified Gold (Latin) by the RIAA in 2014.

en.who: Yandel is the stage name of Llandel Veguilla Malavé, a Puerto Rican singer and member of the reggaeton duo Wisin & Yandel.
facts: He released his first solo album, Quien Contra Mí, in 2003.
His second solo studio album, De Líder a Leyenda, was released in 2013 and certified Gold (Latin) by the RIAA in 2014.

de.who: Yandel ist das Künstlerpseudonym von Llandel Veguilla Malavé, einem puertoricanischen Sänger und Mitglied des Reggaeton-Duos Wisin & Yandel.
facts: Sein erstes Soloalbum Quien Contra Mí erschien 2003.
Sein zweites Soloalbum De Líder a Leyenda erschien 2013 und wurde 2014 von der RIAA in Gold (Latin) ausgezeichnet.

tr.who: Yandel, Llandel Veguilla Malavé'nin sahne adıdır; Portorikolu bir şarkıcı ve reggaeton ikilisi Wisin & Yandel'in üyesidir.
facts: İlk solo albümü Quien Contra Mí 2003'te çıktı.
İkinci solo stüdyo albümü De Líder a Leyenda 2013'te çıktı ve 2014'te RIAA tarafından Gold (Latin) sertifikası aldı.
